questions.explanation: Oppenauer oxidation of pregnenolone converts the 3-beta-hydroxyl group into a 3-keto group with the double bond shifting from 5 to 4, yielding progesterone.

questions.question_text: The biological half- life of drug

options.A: It is a constant physical property of the drug
options.B: It is a constant chemical property of the drug
options.C: It may be increased in patients with impaired renal failure
options.D: It may be decreased in patients by giving the rapid IV injection

questions.question_text: Water resistance of glass container are tested by measuring

options.A: Amount of alkali released into water

questions.question_text: Digoxin:

options.A: Has Its action terminated by metabolism in the liver
options.B: Has A plasma t1/2 of 6 hours
options.C: Should be given half of its normal dose to hypothyroid patients

options.B: The amount of drug in the original dosage from
options.D: The amount of drug excreted in the urine
